lines: 玄天大陆，大魏国，高邈朝堂之上。
此刻，大将，文臣，诸位门阀之主，皇族成员，齐聚于此。
他们排列两边，看着下方浑身是血的少年。
这少年，名叫林辰，大魏国将门林氏少主，年少有为，乃年轻一辈天资第一！
年纪轻轻，便已经修炼到了第四境凝意境，破了整个大魏国有史以来最年轻凝意武者的纪录！
甚至青玄神门都打算收此子为徒！
世人皆言，林氏将再添一位专术境的大武者！
后来，魏国之虎林澜大帅在边境遭受重创，退回国都养伤，作为人子，林辰接替父亲，小小年纪，率领林家军在边境打出六次大捷！
武功震慑全境！
时人皆称，大魏国得此麒麟子，可保国运百年不衰！
皇室为奖赏林辰，更是将最为宠爱的小公主许配给他！
林氏荣耀，一时无两！
只是谁能想到，就在三天前还是帝国红极一时的少年将军，今日，却被囚于阶下，浑身经脉尽数被挑断，修为全废！
只因为，他通敌叛国，要颠覆大魏国祚！
“林辰，你通敌叛国，勾结上吴国之兵，意欲颠覆大魏，自立为王，你可知罪！”
一声大喝响彻整个宫殿。
这声音的主人。
站在文臣武将第一列，就在王座下首，可见位极人臣的权势！
此人，威武不凡，浑身上下皆是铁血杀气，正是帝国唯二的大帅，赵无极！
赵氏，乃大魏老牌将门，跟随开国皇帝打下江山。
林氏在他面前，不过是新贵。
“知罪？”
林辰被打断双腿，跪在地上，他喉间皆是脓血，声音沙哑不堪，“赵帅，你觉得我该知什么罪？”
赵无极神情淡漠，声音低沉冷酷，“自然是通敌叛国的大罪！”
“通敌叛国？”
林辰“哈”
了一声，吐出几口血沫，他低吼着，“我林氏，多少儿郎，年满十六岁就会上战场，为大魏拼杀！”
“我大哥，十六岁入边军，十九岁战死沙场！”
“我二哥，十六岁入边军，十八岁，被上吴国三员大将分尸而亡！”
“我三哥，十六岁入边军，第一战便面对十倍的敌人，死战不退，万箭穿身而死！”
“还有我五弟，他才十四岁，我们都不许他上战场，但他听说有一队斥候被上吴围困，情况危急，他不顾危险赶去救援，他死在了突围战中！”
“他才十四岁，十四岁！
“你们哪一家，可以做到这样，哪一家，有这样的伤亡！”
“但我林氏无悔，帝国将门，热血男儿，保家卫国应是己任，理应前仆后继，无怨无悔！”
“现在，你们告诉我，告诉天下人，我林氏要反，要勾结血海深仇的上吴国，要颠覆大魏国祚！”
“可笑！”
林辰的嘶吼在大殿之中回荡，许多人都是变了神色。
有人忍不住，咬着牙想要往前、出列，为林氏喊冤！
有人红着双眼，他不愿看到林氏忠烈，最终却落得如此下场！
何等不公！
content_en:
Xuantian Continent, the Great Wei State, above Gaomiao Chaotang.
At this moment, generals, civil servants, heads of clans, and members of the royal family are gathered here.
They lined up on both sides and looked at the young man covered in blood below.
This young man's name is Lin Chen. He is the young master of the Lin family, a general in the Wei Kingdom. He is young and promising, and is the most talented among the younger generation!
At such a young age, he has already cultivated to the fourth level of condensing the mind, breaking the record of being the youngest condensing warrior in the history of the entire Wei Kingdom!
Even the Qingxuan Divine Sect plans to accept this boy as a disciple!
Everyone is saying that the Lin family will have another great martial artist in the martial arts realm!
Later, General Lin Lan, the tiger of Wei State, suffered heavy losses at the border and returned to the capital to recuperate. As a son, Lin Chen succeeded his father. At a young age, he led the Lin family army to six great victories on the border!
The martial arts shocks the whole country!
Everyone at that time said that if the Wei Kingdom had this Qilin Son, it would ensure that the country's fortunes would not decline for a hundred years!
In order to reward Lin Chen, the royal family even betrothed their favorite little princess to him!
Lin's glory is unparalleled!
But who would have thought that just three days ago, the young general who was a hit in the empire would be imprisoned under the command, with all his meridians cut off and his cultivation completely ruined!
Just because he collaborated with the enemy and treason, and wanted to overthrow the great Wei State Zuo!
"Lin Chen, you collaborated with the enemy and treason, colluded with the soldiers of the Wu State, and intended to overthrow the Wei Dynasty and establish yourself as king. Do you know your crime?"
A loud shout echoed throughout the palace.
The owner of this voice.
Standing in the first row of civil servants and generals, just below the throne, you can see the power of this extremely powerful minister!
This man is extremely powerful and full of murderous aura. He is none other than the empire's only commander-in-chief, Zhao Wuji!
The Zhao family is a veteran general of the Wei Dynasty, who followed the founding emperor to conquer the country.
In front of him, Lin was just a new rich man.
"Convicted?"
Lin Chen's legs were broken and he knelt on the ground. His throat was full of pus and blood, and his voice was hoarse. "Shuai Zhao, what crime do you think I should be convicted of?"
Zhao Wuji looked indifferent and his voice was low and cold, "Of course it is a serious crime of collaborating with the enemy and treason!"
"Collaboration with the enemy and treason?"
Lin Chen "Ha"
He made a sound, spat out a few mouthfuls of blood, and roared, "I, the Lin family, will go to the battlefield and fight for the Wei Dynasty when I reach the age of sixteen!"
"My eldest brother joined the border army at the age of sixteen and died in battle at the age of nineteen!"
"My second brother joined the border army at the age of sixteen. At the age of eighteen, he was quartered and killed by three generals of the State of Wu!"
"My third brother joined the border army at the age of sixteen. In the first battle, he faced ten times the enemy. He refused to retreat and was pierced by thousands of arrows and died!"
"And my fifth brother, he was only fourteen years old and we didn't allow him to go to the battlefield, but he heard that a group of scouts were besieged by Shangwu and was in critical condition. He rushed to rescue regardless of the danger. He died in the breakout battle!"
"He's only fourteen years old, fourteen years old!
! "
"Which of you can do this, and which one of you can have such casualties!"
"But I, the Lin family, have no regrets. I am a general of the empire and a passionate man. It is my duty to protect my family and the country. I should continue to work hard and have no regrets!"
"Now, tell me, tell the people in the world, I, the Lin family, want to rebel, collude with the bloody feuding Shang Wu State, and overthrow the great Wei State Zuo!"
"Ridiculous!"
Lin Chen's roar echoed in the hall, and many people's expressions changed.
Some people couldn't help but gritted their teeth and wanted to move forward, stand out, and cry out for Lin's injustice!
Someone's eyes were red. He didn't want to see the loyal Lin family end up like this!
How unfair!
